method: Ran the seven-check offline whole-lesson verifier and preserved eight-check ERR-140 verifier. Compiled and executed the full Python demo in a private TMPDIR, compared complete stdout byte-for-byte with the published text fence, and verified the pre-existing sentinel survives while the demo temp directory is cleaned. Reviewed OWASP Authorization and SSRF guidance, Linux pathname lookup/openat2, and Python tempfile.mkdtemp cleanup semantics. Ran full project tests, evidence validation, typecheck, lint, depth checks and baseline verification; built 401 static pages and a 401-page Pagefind index. Captured the whole lesson in light and dark themes; checked final heading rendering, article width, viewport overflow, Mermaid and stylesheet response. No provider or external network calls.
limitations: Historical model-quality, cost, latency, and provider compatibility summaries remain unreproducible because original requests, responses, exact model snapshot, usage records, and scorer were not archived.
The local path fixture does not verify a production OS sandbox, race-safe filesystem boundary, deployed identity/object authorization, URL fetcher, or network egress enforcement.
The browser render confirms this production build at a 1300px viewport; it does not establish behavior on every device or deployment environment.
